items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: No. I never did get to hear him in person. I heard some of his records and I heard him on the radio

ctx.x: Did you ever hear that White piano player he's always going on about -- Peck Kelly?
Peck Kelly? No. I never did get to hear him in person. I heard some of his records and I heard him on the radio, but I never did get to hear him in person.
He's supposed to be good, isn't he?
